description: The five multi-valued region aliases that are three ALPHA characters - ANT, NTZ, SCG, SUN, YUG. BCP 47 reads a three-letter subtag after a language as an extlang, and Locale.forLanguageTag promotes it to primary language, so these aliases can never reach the region-alias table. Catalogs for the resulting languages are loaded to make the collapse observable rather than merely absent; ru and sr are loaded as the languages the caller thought they were asking for.
